toolSpec.name: getAthleteProfile
toolSpec.description: Retrieves the athlete's biometrics, 4-parameter Xert fitness signature, starred segment list, and additional watch-list segment IDs from DynamoDB. Use this tool when assessing power-to-weight ratios, threshold boundaries, sprint capacity, or segment curation.

athleteId.description: Canonical Strava numeric athlete ID stored as a string (e.g., '3634905').

toolSpec.name: searchSegments
toolSpec.description: Searches the segment catalog using in-memory fuzzy matching on segment names. Returns normalized segment objects with IDs, geography, climb stats, KOM/QOM, and match scores. If 'q' is omitted, returns the full catalog.

q.description: Fuzzy search query term matching segment names (e.g., 'toys hill', 'coll de femenia', 'frittenden').

toolSpec.name: getSegmentDetails
toolSpec.description: Retrieves segment metadata including route elevation high/low, coordinates, climb statistics, and all-time leaderboard benchmarks (KOM/QOM). Reads from DynamoDB cache with zero quota consumption unless refresh=true is requested.

athleteId.description: Optional Strava athlete ID. Only required if 'refresh' is set to true to authorize an upstream fetch.

refresh.description: Force an immediate upstream cache refresh from Strava instead of reading cached DynamoDB records.

toolSpec.name: getSegmentEfforts
toolSpec.description: Retrieves compact historical attempts by the athlete on a specific segment. Each effort includes activity ID, effort ID, elapsed and moving times, power meter wattage, heart rate, cadence, and pipeline-computed all-time competition ranking (personal_pr_rank).

order.description: Chronological sort order by attempt start timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of historical efforts to return.

toolSpec.name: syncStarredSegments
toolSpec.description: Fetches starred segments from Strava and overwrites the athlete's 'starred_segment_list' in DynamoDB. Fast execution that does not initiate background enrichment.

athleteId.description: Canonical Strava numeric athlete ID to synchronize (e.g., '3634905').

toolSpec.name: manageAdditionalSegments
toolSpec.description: Appends to or completely replaces the athlete's curated 'additional_segment_list' in DynamoDB.

segmentIds.description: List of numeric segment IDs to add or replace.

action.description: Action to perform: 'append' (POST) adds and deduplicates against the existing list; 'replace' (PUT) overwrites the entire list.

toolSpec.name: triggerEnrichmentSync
toolSpec.description: Asynchronously initiates background enrichment for all segments in both 'starred_segment_list' and 'additional_segment_list'. Deduplicates IDs, pushes batches of 10 to SQS, and returns an immediate HTTP 202 Accepted.

athleteId.description: Canonical Strava numeric athlete ID whose combined segment lists should be synced (e.g., '3634905').

toolSpec.name: predictSegmentEffort
toolSpec.description: Predicts all-out cycling performance (expected power in Watts, completion time in seconds, confidence bounds, and model certainty) using an aerodynamic and metabolic equilibrium model. Supports two modes: (1) using a known segment ID and athlete ID, or (2) using custom climb geometry and explicit fitness parameters.

segmentId.description: Optional canonical Strava segment identifier (e.g., '6807785'). Used for Option 1.

athleteId.description: Canonical Strava athlete ID (e.g., '3634905'). Used in Option 1 to look up stored biometrics and fitness profile.

distance_m.description: Total climb distance in meters. Required for custom calculation (Option 2).

elevation_gain_m.description: Total elevation gain in meters. Required for custom calculation (Option 2).

rider_mass_kg.description: Rider body mass in kilograms (excluding bike/kit). Required for custom calculation (Option 2).

fitness_profile.description: Metabolic power profile parameters. Required for custom calculation (Option 2).

threshold_power_watts.description: Functional Threshold Power (FTP) or Critical Power in Watts.

high_intensity_energy_kj.description: High Intensity Energy (HIE) or anaerobic work capacity (W') in kilojoules.

peak_power_watts.description: Neuromuscular peak power ceiling in Watts.
